notes.title: A Huge Thank You and Patch 1.07
notes.content:
Cache Grabbers has been out for about 6 weeks and it makes me so happy that people have been playing the game and leaving such positive reviews. To those of you that have bought the game, I can't thank you enough, your support allows me to keep pushing forward. And for those of you that still have Cache Grabbers on your wishlist, there might be a Steam Sale Discount coming soon, hopefully that will entice you. 

I had a few reports that videos like the Bear Minimum Games Logo and the Epilogue were not appearing correctly on the Steam Deck, turns out the video codec I was using was not supported on Linux. I fixed that and updated all versions to 1.07 not long ago. I'd love to request a Steam Deck review and get my green checkmark, but those tools are still unavailable to me as a new, solo developer. Just know that friends of mine have played on Steam Deck and tell me it works great!

With that, there are no outstanding items or bugs and I'm already well into my next project. I'd love to hear any suggestions or feedback you all have (perhaps a Cache Grabbers sequel or DLC is in the future) and will of course immediately jump on any more bugs you all find. Reviews are always super helpful and spreading the word keeps the lights on around here. Thank you all so much!
